ruleDefinitions.name: Added Credentials to Existing Application
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects when a new credential is added to an existing application. Any additional credentials added outside of expected processes could be a malicious actor using those credentials. Note: Unmapped fields: properties.message

sequences.query: (properties.message = "Update\ application\ –\ Certificates\ and\ secrets\ management" OR properties.message = "Update\ Service\ principal\/Update\ Application")
